ValidationRule.description: Please ensure phone number is 10 digits long with no alpha numeric.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
/* This part is to make sure the rule doesn't fire on a blank value Not() is used because the validation rule fires when it is true, we want it to fire when it is not blank */
NOT(ISBLANK(Phone_Number__c)),
OR( /* This First Part is an If Statement to ensure the number is 10 digits long and logically checks if it has an extension in the format of xdddd or x dddd only 4 digits is possible */ IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,5), "x[0-9]{4}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x[0-9]{4}")),
IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,4), "x[0-9]{3}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x[0-9]{3}")),
IF(
AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,3), "x[0-9]{2}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x[0-9]{2}")),
IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,2), "x[0-9]{1}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x[0-9]{1}")),
IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,6), "x\\ [0-9]{4}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x\\ [0-9]{4}")),
IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,5), "x\\ [0-9]{3}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x\\ [0-9]{3}")),
IF(
AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,4), "x\\ [0-9]{2}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x\\ [0-9]{2}")),
IF( AND(OR(Contains(Phone_Number__c, "x") , Contains(Phone_Number__c,"x")),REGEX(RIGHT(Phone_Number__c,3), "x\\ [0-9]{1}")),
NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}\\-[0-9]{4} x\\ [0-9]{1}")),
IF( LEFT(Phone_Number__c,1)="(", NOT( REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\([0-9]{3}\\) [0-9]{3}-[0-9]{4}|\\d{10}")), NOT(REGEX(Phone_Number__c, "\\D*?(\\d\\D*?){10}"))
))))))))),
/* This part is to ensure that the number is not XXXXXXXXXX. NOTE: this does not work with 1111111111 */ mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid (Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid (Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) + mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 1) = mid(Phone_Number__c, 2, 3)+ mid(Phone_Number__c, 7, 3)+ mid(Phone_Number__c, 11, 4),
/* This is to ensure the Phone_Number__c is not 1111111111 */ Phone_Number__c = "1111111111"
))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure phone number is 10 digits long with no alpha numeric.
